summary: Backend, PostgreSQL and Android automated gates passed; Stage is BLOCKED only on Android install/start runtime acceptance because the local Emulator 37.1.11 exits before ADB becomes usable.

commands.result: Six-module reactor BUILD SUCCESS; 3 domain tests and 3 Spring/Flyway/JPA/API tests passed.
53 tasks completed; Android unit test, lint and debug APK assembly passed.

Emulator process started but emulator-5554 remained offline after the initial 60-second timeout and a 40-second reconnect attempt; APK installation and launch were not executed. The two emulator processes started by this run were stopped.

commands.command: Temporary postgres:16-alpine container on 127.0.0.1:55432 plus .\mvnw.cmd test
commands.result: PostgreSQL 16.15 accepted Flyway V1, Hibernate validate completed, and the test asserted one successful migration plus all six core tables. The no-volume --rm container was stopped and removed.

commands.command: Create FamilyGrowth_Stage2_API34 on D:\AndroidAvd\FamilyGrowth and boot with supported software/WHPX renderer combinations
commands.result: C-drive capacity issue was eliminated by moving the new project-only AVD to D. Emulator 37.1.11 headless QEMU still exited or remained offline before sys.boot_completed; APK install/start stayed NOT_RUN. Existing user AVD data was not cleared.

commands.command: Official sdkmanager uninstall emulator; sdkmanager emulator; emulator-check accel
commands.result: The global Emulator package was fully reinstalled from the official SDK repository. Version remained 37.1.11 and WHPX 10.0.22624 reported usable. Existing AVDs and system images were preserved.

commands.command: Recreate project-only API 34 Pixel Tablet AVD and boot after Emulator reinstall
commands.result: Both headless and hidden-window launches started QEMU but no emulator console/ADB device became usable; QEMU then exited or remained idle. APK install/start/rotation stayed NOT_RUN.
No whitespace errors at the captured checkpoint.

limitations: Android emulator install/start is not validated. A project-only API 34 Pixel Tablet AVD on D drive also fails before ADB is usable under Emulator 37.1.11.

A same-version official reinstall of Emulator 37.1.11 did not resolve the runtime issue. The next environment action requires either reinstalling the shared API 34 system image or using a physical Android device.
AGP 8.7.3 was tested by Google up to compileSdk 35, while this build uses installed compileSdk 36 because current Compose dependencies require at least 35 and SDK 35 is absent.
Authentication and parent PIN are intentionally outside Stage 2; current API is not production-deployable.
